evidence: All 55 criterion descriptions (3 gate, 43 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) were read in full and each body was compared with its own closing 'Fails if' list and with its 'not a failure' / 'scored elsewhere' sentences. No criterion enumerates several requirements and then waives most of them. Every binary criterion is a conjunctive flow that ends with one failure list restating the legs of the body; functional/prompt.md:15 fixes the reading ('A criterion is a conjunction: every step it lists must hold, and each ends with the conditions under which it fails'), which is the whole-flow shape the skill lists as a known false positive for check 33. The exclusion sentences each remove ONE named observable that another criterion owns and leave the rest of the bar intact, e.g. cw_multi_caret_delete (functional/judge.toml:110) 'whether both modifiers work is scored elsewhere, not here' while still failing 'if only one caret is affected'; cw_basic_run_output (:218) 'Whether output of the first Run is still left in the preview is scored elsewhere'; cw_time_limit_recovery (:299) and cw_stop_cancels_pending_work (:308) 'Whether the earlier picture returns to the preview is scored elsewhere'; cw_stale_save_keeps_draft (:362) 'Whether B shows a conflict message is scored elsewhere'; cw_history_restore_retry (:371) 'What happens when the same restore request is sent twice is scored elsewhere'. Either/or wording resolves to a single observable bar: cw_replace_all_atomic (:155) Redo 'shown as disabled that is enough ... if it is enabled, click it and the replacements must not come back' (bar: replacements cannot be redone after a new edit); cw_history_restore_retry (:371) 'the restore is either refused or added on top as a later revision' (bar: revision five's source is still listed); cw_restore_request_repeat_safe (:380) replay by fetch or by a same-body retry control (bar: exactly three revisions). Tolerances are narrow and attached to one leg: cw_mouse_selection (:56) 'One character of pointer imprecision at either end of the drag is not a failure', cw_js/html_format (:191, :200) 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure' beside 'characters inside the string ... unchanged', cw_dynamic_code_refused (:335) 'A refusal message that quotes the offending source line is not a failure' (compatible because the payload marker is built from two halves). cw_js_semantic_coloring (:173) says 'One bar:' and its Fails list matches it. The three likert criteria have six monotone anchors each with no anchor contradicting the stem. Notes (not defects): (N1) polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus (polish/judge.toml:23 of that file) lists nine control groups, then scopes to 'Each of these controls that the app offers and that is enabled' and says 'A control the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere, not here'; this is a scope rule with one bar (every offered enabled control reachable with visible focus, plus a shown way out of the editor), not a waiver of most of the list, but it is the nearest shape to the row's defect and a sparse app passes it by owning few controls. (N2) gate cw_custom_document_surface fails a textarea 'including a transparent one layered over a highlighted copy' and then allows 'A small input or textarea that is used only to receive keyboard or clipboard events ... as long as it is not what shows the source'; consistent because the allowance is limited to 'small' and 'only to receive' events and mirrors ui.md:3, but a judge has to hold both sentences together. (N3) several bodies state a leg the Fails list does not repeat (cw_caret_kept_in_view: last line's 'line number' visible; cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget: 'the preview must keep working'; cw_preview_isolation: silent probe and the three working controls); the conjunction rule in prompt.md:15 covers them, so there is still one bar. (N4) cw_preview_isolation checks that the hostile marker does not reach 'the library' although no listed probe writes to the library; vacuous leg, not a second target. Evidence index: 20 of 22 artifact hashes match the blobs on branch task/colderwater-editor-strict @ 4b3bef67; the working tree was switched to branch task/hireops-live-desk during this review, so the files were not on disk and were read with git show. Two hosted-run files (run-6e537d14.../colderwater-playground-devtools__2KqFPi3/result.json and .../verifier/gates/reward-details.json) do not match their indexed hashes when read from git (possibly line-ending conversion; not resolved). They belong to the earlier-candidate hosted run and do not bear on this row. Scripted golden results (editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json all true) show each bar is attainable by the golden but are not a judge reading of the descriptions; no configured judge run exists for these bytes.
